facts.text: Grab a plate, Lewis. Grandpa's built a machine for the peanut butter and jelly, so stand back a bit.
facts.why: The peanut butter and jelly machine is Lewis's own invention, from his demo for the Harringtons. Grandpa did not build it. The Robinsons' dinner is the meatball battle.
facts.fix: Grab a plate, Lewis. Dinner here is a meatball battle, so duck, and keep moving forward.

facts.why: A film-detail page calls Todayland a play on Tomorrowland, but nothing opened says what it is in the story or that it is a cafe, so the claim is unproven.
The science fair is at Lewis's school in his own time, and the dialogue never ties it to a place called Todayland.

facts.text: The bright future city of Todayland.
facts.why: The name shows up only as a play on Tomorrowland in one fan page, and no page opened says it is the name of the future city.
facts.fix: The bright future, Lewis's family home.

vibe.verdict: The meatball cannon dinner and the peanut butter and jelly bites hit, but the airline layout feels unlike the film's family chaos.
